{
  "name": "lecomax",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "scripts": {
    "predev": "npm run generate:course && npm run source:refresh",
    "source:refresh": "node scripts/source-library.mjs",
    "dev": "next dev",
    "prebuild": "npm run validate:course && npm run source:refresh",
    "build": "node scripts/next-build.mjs",
    "test": "node --test tests/*.test.ts && npm run -s test:android-back",
    "test:android-back": "node mobile/scripts/test-android-back.mjs",
    "test:preorder": "node --test tests/preorder.test.ts tests/preorder-api.test.ts tests/preorder-retry.test.ts tests/mobile-cart-reconciliation.test.ts && node scripts/test-preorder-sql.mjs",
    "start": "next start",
    "lint": "next lint",
    "generate:course": "node scripts/generate-course.mjs",
    "prevalidate:course": "npm run generate:course",
    "validate:course": "node scripts/validate-course.mjs",
    "audit:supabase": "node --env-file=.env.local scripts/audit-supabase.mjs",
    "audit:loyalty": "node --env-file=.env.local scripts/audit-loyalty.mjs",
    "audit:admin-api": "node scripts/audit-admin-api-contracts.mjs",
    "audit:mobile-secrets": "node scripts/audit-mobile-secrets.mjs",
    "audit:mobile-interactions": "node scripts/audit-mobile-interactions.mjs",
    "smoke:course-ui": "node scripts/smoke-course-ui.mjs",
    "smoke:source-library": "node scripts/smoke-course-ui.mjs --source-only",
    "smoke:admin-dashboard": "node scripts/smoke-admin-dashboard-ui.mjs",
    "smoke:mobile-responsive": "node scripts/smoke-mobile-responsive-ui.mjs",
    "smoke:daily-training": "node scripts/smoke-course-ui.mjs --daily-only",
    "owner:setup": "node scripts/setup-learning-owner.mjs",
    "owner:check": "node scripts/check-learning-owner.mjs",
    "owner:dev": "npm run owner:check && next dev --hostname 0.0.0.0",
    "owner:start": "npm run owner:check && next start",
    "test:owner-auth": "node --test tests/owner-auth.test.ts tests/owner-session.test.ts tests/owner-http.test.ts",
    "owner:cleanup": "node scripts/cleanup-learning-owner.mjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@emailjs/browser": "^4.4.1",
    "@paypal/react-paypal-js": "^10.0.0",
    "@supabase/supabase-js": "^2.105.0",
    "@types/mailparser": "^3.4.6",
    "@types/nodemailer": "^8.0.1",
    "@types/web-push": "^3.6.4",
    "@vercel/analytics": "^2.0.1",
    "@vercel/speed-insights": "^2.0.0",
    "argon2": "^0.45.1",
    "imapflow": "^1.4.7",
    "mailparser": "^3.9.26",
    "next": "^15.5.24",
    "nodemailer": "^9.1.1",
    "openai": "^6.42.0",
    "pg": "^8.23.1",
    "react": "^19.0.0",
    "react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "react-markdown": "^10.1.0",
    "remark-gfm": "^4.0.1",
    "resend": "^6.17.2",
    "sanitize-html": "^2.17.7",
    "sharp": "^0.35.4",
    "web-push": "^3.6.7"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@electric-sql/pglite": "^0.5.8",
    "@types/node": "^22.9.0",
    "@types/react": "^19.0.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "@types/sanitize-html": "^2.16.1",
    "acorn": "^8.17.0",
    "autoprefixer": "^10.4.20",
    "eslint": "^8.57.1",
    "eslint-config-next": "^15.5.24",
    "postcss": "8.5.23",
    "tailwindcss": "^3.4.15",
    "tus-js-client": "^4.3.1",
    "typescript": "^5.7.2"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "postcss": "$postcss",
    "sharp": "$sharp",
    "ws": "8.21.0"
  }
}
